project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: GUID of the project the nodes belong to. One project per call - each one installs into its own libraries and commits its own history.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.description: Local name of the catalog publishing the library. Omit for a library the project owns, whose versions are read from its own libraries/.versions/ instead.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the library to move the nodes onto.

version.title: Version
version.description: Version to move to. Defaults to the newest the catalog publishes.

workflow_guid.title: Workflow Guid
workflow_guid.description: GUID of the workflow containing the node.

node_guid.title: Node Guid
node_guid.description: GUID of the node to move onto the new version.

targets.title: Targets
targets.description: The nodes to update. Nodes are chosen explicitly rather than updated wholesale, because moving a node onto new library code is a decision per node.
